name: birthday-planner
description: Local-first birthday party planner for kids

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @birthday-planner/core && npm run lint -w @birthday-planner/ui
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w @birthday-planner/core && npm run lint:fix -w @birthday-planner/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @birthday-planner/core && npm run typecheck -w @birthday-planner/ui
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @birthday-planner/core && npm run test:coverage -w @birthday-planner/ui
